    2. Inside it, one chip.Sensors in, a small fine-tuned AI model, a prediction out.

    3. The small fine-tuned model, on the chip.Current flows from the sensor inputs, through the model, to the prediction.

    You describe the device. The AI scientist builds the chip.

    1. 1You describe a device and what it must detect
    2. 2AI scientists propose chip designs

    4. 4The best compile into logic gates, weights wired in

    Early feasibility test

    2,330 gates

    One small heart-rhythm detector became 2,330 logic gates. Each square above is one gate.

    Early feasibility test

    3,880 of 3,880

    The circuit matched its model on all 3,880 test windows.

    Early feasibility test, 21 November 2026, on a laptop. Not yet clinical. Accuracy is not yet at clinical level. This test shows the pipeline runs end to end.

    Smaller, then smaller.

    The AI scientist keeps the smallest chip that still does the job.

    • Uses less power
    • Lasts longer on a battery
    • Costs less
    • Fits inside the device
